"We Help people who have been affected by NEUROLOGICAL disorders get back to doing the things they love!"

TheraFit Rehab® is dedicated to providing specialized, activity-based rehabilitation & fitness programs to children, adults, and seniors with disabilities. We strive to rehabilitate our patients and restore their quality of life. Our specialized facility offers fully accessible and adaptive equipment including the Quadriciser®.

We serve people of all ages with disabilities including Cerebral Palsy, Multiple Sclerosis, Spinal Cord Injury, Traumatic Brain Injury, Stroke, Paraplegia, Muscular Dystrophy, Spina Bifida, Quadriplegia, Parkinson's, Developmental Delays, Autism, movement disorders, dystonia, and other debilitating aliments. We also serve seniors with conditions such as arthritis, diabetes, heart and lung disease, and other age-related problems.
